items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: Whether it's as valuable as a piece of art I don't know. Duke's certainly was; whether mine was, I don't know.

ctx.x: Frankly, I think it's--just to take an arbitrary example, "Superman" is just a good a piece and as ambitious a piece as "A Concerto for Cootie" that Duke wrote for Cootie, and works just as well.

Whether it's as valuable as a piece of art I don't know. Duke's certainly was; whether mine was, I don't know. It wasn't done for that reason, it was done just to do it. It worked out to be fine, but that piece is a little longer.
